# Bugs in docsync that are fixed, by docsync's own bug number. Each must be
# referenced by a test or an e2e script that proves the fix, in the form
# "bug N", "(bug N)" or "bugs N, M and K" -- TestEveryFixedBugIsPinned fails
# for any that is not.
#
# The numbers are the order the bugs were reported in; the original reports
# are archived with the maintainers, not in this repository. When a bug is
# fixed, add it here in the same change as its test. A duplicate is listed
# with the bug that carries its fix.
1  cross-repo references never flagged when the cited block changed
2  secret values written to the extraction cache and the journal
3  ds undo reached past the last commit and could delete a cited def
4  anchoring a markdown heading changed the previous section's hash
5  ds check not reproducible across repositories
6  ds status snapshot staleness, and ds prune for the body store
7  ds def on .adoc/.rst rejected #Symbol
8  cross-repo moved never reported
9  ds notify raises a stale snapshot
10 ds notify lost dedupe state on every CI run (duplicate of 11)
11 ds notify had no memory between CI runs
12 an extraction-rule change reported every citation as changed
13 a citation's sentence across wrapped lines and abbreviations
14 --dry-run for ds ack and ds publish
15 finding the repository root from a subdirectory
16 the old-content hook could not name a per-environment row
17 acks under another rule rejected though their sentence was unchanged
18 a const inside a const ( ... ) group bound a later declaration
19 ds def missed a standalone typed Go constant
20 policy.require_doc and the unmarked report skipped every file a syntax tier read
21 ds github comment left each block diff fence open
22 the text inside a Go string literal was not part of the block hash
23 finding diff taken from git at the ledger header commit instead of the body store, unchecked by hash
24 diff since an ack showed the first-seen body instead of the acked one
25 ack without a prior scan did not store the acked body
26 ds check text output never printed the diff
27 changed one-value constant classified body, not value
28 missing old body classified body, so stability=api passed a signature change checked without a scan
29 failed ds:run under check --run exited 1 with no finding
30 summary counted passing findings as "none"
31 report --stalest order depended on which second acks landed in
32 find, map and same-line check findings ordered by random id suffix
33 adopt and def dry runs printed ids the real run did not write
34 report --unmarked and --gaps listed doc pages
40 ds def wrote a trailing directive into properties/INI values
41 ds def path#Holder.member failed for TypeScript and Python
42 shell functions had no symbol and ds def could not find them
43 ds def path:A-B silently used line A
44 ds render left the bare ds:def line in .txt pages
45 remote JSON def recorded at line 1
46 .mts .cts .cjs .pyi .tfvars had no comment style
47 spec said a relabelled citation resolves; it is broken with a suggestion
48 ds def path#Name used a line matcher instead of the scanning tier
49 span= ignored by the YAML, TOML and HCL tiers
50 multi-line directive comment silently dropped
51 link-form directive with spaces silently dropped
52 quoted link-form value kept its quotes
53 remote defs with different picks on one line reported as one block
54 type= validated nothing
55 malformed ids accepted
56 remedies named a nonexistent [scan] key and the ds:table remedy for cfg query=
57 ds def .gitignore:1 could not derive a label
58 ds def on a directive line inserted a second directive; crossing blocks not reported
59 two inline facts on one line reported as one block
60 render --at took line ranges and permalink commit from HEAD; git error blamed the repository
61 context --since <commit> ignored and any value accepted
62 context --since ack / --mode diff disagreed with check's diff
63 context <id> omitted block-position citations
64 rendered links were repository-relative, broken from docs/
65 context with no budget printed "of 0"
66 ds:block at=<sha> rendered only a link in plain render
67 ds:cfg block form passed check but render rejected it
68 ds lsp ignored the client's rootUri
69 github comment --dry-run required GITHUB_TOKEN/REPOSITORY
70 review --out only worked with --ai
71 undo --list called moved committed writes uncommitted and named HEAD
72 claim about= stayed expired after ack until ds scan
73 ack --from-commit ignored note=
74 rename rewrote ids in an exported audit log
75 a check --json report inside the repo was scanned as citations
76 SPEC showed ds ack <id> --note without --doc/--line
77 refresh with nothing to record rewrote ledger and refs
80 op:// addresses looked for ds-resolve-1password, but the shipped plugin is ds-resolve-onepassword
81 ds-resolve-vault passed the vault: prefix to vault kv get
82 ds-resolve-onepassword reported any op failure as does not exist
83 resolve.enabled ignored, no ds-resolve-env, resolver findings carried the URL remedy
84 no stale copy state after a rotation
85 local=true def unverifiable even where its file is present
86 ds:run timeout= ignored, no expect HTTP-status mode, substring expect ignored exit status
87 ds:url expect= ignored, network failure reported dead and cached for url.ttl
100 publish into a local-directory index wrote without committing
101 workspace stale_after_commits and index were parsed and unused
102 another repository's citation printed without its repository; its ack remedy failed where printed
103 ds why missed citers in other repositories
104 a git-URL index blocked ds def and ds scan until the first ds sync
105 repo-mode copies of another repository's block had no body and a broken link; render printed copies twice; refresh --dry-run omitted copies
106 MCP ack accepted any delegated_by and recorded the actor as mcp
107 MCP impact tool had no staged mode
108 ds init --agents narrower than SPEC 26.10
109 GitHub action README promised an ack commit the action never made
110 publish workflow template never produced the junit.xml it published
111 Docusaurus 3.10 site did not build with the documented configuration
112 Hugo status partial listed every reference on every page

126 cli.WithName still printed ds in version and remedies; secret ds:cfg render gave a misleading warning

128 ds scan read checkouts nested in the repository (worktrees, cloned dependencies) as part of it
129 a repo-mode copy that only moved was reported tampered, and old-style copies failed check on upgrade
130 the VS Code extension never started: its client ran ds lsp --stdio, which ds rejected
131 clicking a ds: link in markdown in VS Code failed with Unable to resolve resource
132 a remote def could not bind a YAML mapping or TOML table: the pick refused it as a multi-line value
133 a remote def could not bind a code symbol: pick=symbol: was unsupported
134 a multi-line value pick said "use ds:block" even when the citation already was ds:block
